instruction: Pivot-style grid table with row/column hierarchy (GridTable / S2), not a flat row table.

dimensions.names: provide dimension names separated by comma, min 1 max any

measures: provide measure names separated by comma, min 1 max any

color.description: Solid hex string or palette array of hex colors

instructions: GridTable = AntV S2 wrapper (NOT Ant Design Table). Keep the VF SHORT — use helperFunctions.buildGridTableReport.
1) Replace dimensions/measures with real result-column keys from data/SQL (must match Object.keys(data[0])).
2) First dim -> row, remaining dims -> column; measures are values. Pass formatStrings when Excel formats are provided.
3) Do not inline a full report/properties blob (it truncates under max_tokens). Never use <Table />.
4) Keep crosstab totals on unless the user asks to disable (showTotals: true).
